checks.ref:
command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
review="$change/review-specs.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-specs stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Coverage table omits requirement ids NG1–NG5 and Q1–Q3 from proposal.md, even though .claude/rules/traceability.md lists NG and Q among requirement ID formats and the table does include G1–G3 and M1–M5.

Summary says '20/22' requirements are fully covered, but its own list (FR1–FR10, NFR-P1, NFR-A1, NFR-R1, UX1, M1–M5) is 19 items; with the 3 partial ones that makes 22, and the G ids in the table are not counted.

Missed contradiction: design.md D4 has retry re-import a failed lazy view through a factory that drops the failed promise, but ViewDefinition.component is a LazyExoticComponent (packages/client/src/views/viewDefinition.ts:15) with no loader to call again, and React.lazy keeps the rejection. Retry therefore needs an undeclared change to the ViewDefinition contract from ADR-0005 (or a registry-side factory the design does not describe), and no finding covers it.
